# Public audio fixture

`librispeech-1462-170145-0012.wav` contains the LibriSpeech utterance
1462-170145-0012, "He bent his face over her hair."

LibriSpeech was prepared by Vassil Panayotov with the assistance of Daniel Povey.
The corpus is available from [OpenSLR resource 12](https://www.openslr.org/12/)
under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

This fixture was captured from public corpus playback during TypeWhisper's
upstream 0.18 verification. It is mono, 16 kHz PCM WAV and includes the silence
recorded around the utterance. It contains no microphone input from a person
using TypeWhisper. Keep the attribution when redistributing the fixture.
